upper_division.reason: The reviewed current university policies do not state one separate university-wide upper-division-credit minimum; prescribed upper-level major courses are not an equivalent policy declaration.

residency.rule: At least 25 percent of degree credits must be completed at Virginia Tech; no more than 18 transfer credits may appear among the final 45 credits; no more than 50 percent of degree requirements may transfer from two-year institutions.

modeling_notes: The selected target is the broad Computer Science major under the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, not the separately published Secure Computing or Data-Centric Computing majors.
#programcurriculumtextcontainer is the authoritative 123-credit curriculum. The same program page's #graduationrequirementstextcontainer is complementary policy content and must also be retained.
The roadmap/sample plan outside the Program Curriculum container is scheduling guidance and must not be imported as an additional requirement set.

Pathways concept credits are embedded in the program curriculum and may overlap specified major or elective requirements. Concept 7 is suspended effective fall 2025, so no independent nonoverlapping General Education total is asserted here.
The 27-credit final-block institutional minimum is the arithmetic implication of the published maximum of 18 transfer credits among the final 45, not separately quoted policy text.

data_quality_flags.message: The live catalog program and department pages returned a JavaScript anti-bot challenge during research; use a browser-capable recapture and compare it with the current official-URL snapshot.
Do not sum the displayed Pathways concept rows as a distinct GE block without resolving major overlap and the fall-2025 Concept 7 suspension.
Do not infer a universal upper-division minimum from the program's required 3000/4000/5000-level coursework.
